scope: Selected immutable cairn-core authoritative completion implementation at the same producer revision as the separately consumed gate contract. Kiln calls the producer evaluator rather than recreating its semantics. The existing gate and fixture import remains current and unchanged.
nonclaims: The evaluator checks supplied trusted-execution evidence; importing it does not execute checks, create evidence, grant authority, publish source, or establish release eligibility.
manifest_normalization: Absent workspace members are pruned from the retained root manifest so Cargo resolves only selected packages.
formatter_scope: Tree-local rustfmt.toml disables host formatting of immutable producer source.
